entry.title: New: Resolution 651 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — now tracked
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN INTERGOVERNMENTAL AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH, TO RECEIVE A GRANT FOR THE HAWAIʻI FIRE DEPARTMENT COMMUNITY PARAMEDICINE PROGRAM

Allows for the receipt of $2,355,000 in federally-derived funds to be used to fund personnel, telehealth equipment and software, and provide training, travel, and program implementation materials.
